snippet.title: Stickility - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam Page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/3419140/Stickility/

Welcome to Stickility, a 2D metroidvania game with crafting elements, where as a stickman nicknamed "Axel", you'll be able to explore vast and deep interiors of Biotec, a massive underground research center, filled with creative foes, bosses, npc's, and more. Your task is to find the burrowed truth, and close this place once and for all.

Inspired by Hollow Knight, Crowsworn, Haiku The Robot, and Subnautica.

Official Discord server - https://discord.gg/ttQPJCdFFJ
